# Primadev Store
> Official digital license store by PT Primadev Digital Technology. Instant automated 24/7 license activation, business software, POS cashiers, automation tools, and customer support.

## Overview
Primadev Store (https://store.primadev.id) is the official platform operated by **PT Primadev Digital Technology** for purchasing genuine software licenses, managing license renewals, verifying license authenticity, and obtaining technical customer support.

## Core Information
- **Website**: https://store.primadev.id
- **Main Portal**: https://primadev.id
- **Company Name**: PT Primadev Digital Technology
- **Legal Entity**: Perseroan Perorangan terdaftar di Kementerian Hukum dan HAM RI (Kemenkumham RI)
- **Legal Certificate**: AHU-A104134.AH.01.30.Tahun 2026
- **Headquarters**: Wangon, Kecamatan Wangon, Kabupaten Banyumas, Jawa Tengah 53176, Indonesia
- **Official Email**: support.primadev@gmail.com / admin.primadev@gmail.com
- **Official WhatsApp Support**: +62 838-2952-0561
- **Operating Hours**: 24/7 Automated Activation, Support 1x24 business hours

## Key Pages & Navigation
- [Software Catalog & Home](https://store.primadev.id/): Browse official software products, pricing, and features.
- [License Renewal](https://store.primadev.id/renew): Extend license validity without data loss or re-configuration.
- [License Checker](https://store.primadev.id/check-license): Verify authenticity, registered owner, and expiry date.
- [Customer Support](https://store.primadev.id/support): Technical assistance, activation help, and WhatsApp contact.

## Featured Software Products
1. **Struk SPBU Generator Android**
   - *Platform*: Android
   - *Category*: Business & Fuel Receipt Automation
   - *Plans*: Monthly (Rp 80.000) & Yearly (Rp 860.000)
   - *Description*: Automated digital receipt maker for gas stations (SPBU Pertamina, Shell, BP, etc.) with thermal Bluetooth printer support, custom templates, and instant calculations.

2. **KasirQ POS (Point of Sale)**
   - *Platform*: Android
   - *Category*: Retail & POS Cashier System
   - *Description*: Lightweight, fast cashier application for MSMEs, grocery stores, cafes, and retail shops with inventory control, barcode scanning, and multi-payment reporting.

3. **WA Direct & Automation Blaster Pro**
   - *Platform*: Android & Browser Extension
   - *Category*: Marketing & Direct Messaging Automation
   - *Description*: Direct WhatsApp messaging tool without saving contacts, scheduled follow-ups, and broadcast marketing automation.

## Licensing & Activation Model
- **Instant 24/7 Auto-Activation**: License keys are generated immediately upon verified payment and displayed on-screen and delivered via email.
- **Device Binding**: Keys bind securely to authorized devices for fraud prevention.
- **Seamless Renewal**: Renewing an existing license key accumulates remaining days with no service interruption or reinstallation required.
- **Official PDF Invoice**: Tax-compliant digital PDF invoices are automatically generated and downloadable with every transaction.

## Supported Payment Methods
- **QRIS**: Instant payment via all Indonesian digital wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, LinkAja) and Mobile Banking apps (BCA Mobile, Livin by Mandiri, BRImo, BNI Mobile, etc.).
- **Virtual Accounts**: BCA, Mandiri (eChannel), BNI, BRI, Permata Bank, CIMB Niaga.
- **E-Wallets**: GoPay, ShopeePay, DANA, OVO.
- **Convenience Stores**: Alfamart, Indomaret.
